recognize_zh: 骨髓切片骨小樑間幾乎全被造血細胞占滿、看不到脂肪，以密集的骨髓性（myeloid）細胞為主，巨核細胞稀少，符合 JMML 的高細胞密度骨髓。
features: Markedly hypercellular marrow (near 100%) between bony trabeculae
Diffuse sheets of maturing myeloid/myelomonocytic cells
Megakaryocytes decreased, only occasional forms seen
No discrete blast sheets or granulomas identified at this power
Interspersed dilated sinusoids with red cells
describe_en: H&E section of bone marrow biopsy shows a markedly hypercellular marrow (approaching 100%) with near-complete replacement of fat by sheets of maturing myeloid and myelomonocytic cells. Megakaryocytes are decreased, with only occasional forms identified. No discrete blast aggregates are evident at this magnification. Findings are consistent with a myeloproliferative process such as juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia in the appropriate clinical and genetic context; blast enumeration on aspirate and CD34 IHC are recommended.

ddx.vs: AML shows sheets of blasts (≥20%) with loss of maturation, highlighted by CD34/CD117 IHC.
Reactive hyperplasia preserves megakaryocytes and normal maturation and lacks RAS-pathway mutations.
CML shows small hypolobated megakaryocytes, basophilia and BCR::ABL1 fusion.
